scope: The optional streaming flag applies only to owned scalable injective complete-source aggregates with an eligible audited uniqueness capability.
The false-capability active relation retains one shared materialized DISTINCT. Source admission, typed-domain, range, output and owner/control checks retain their existing logic.
Functional verification covered73candidate methods and6baseline methods, including6new stream/fallback/failure cases.
Direct nativeSQL profiles validate exact fixed-cut sums and physical operators. They are not publicSDK concurrency benchmarks.
Actual candidate profiles omit active/count_source CTE nodes; active_dedup remains for fallback. Baseline count_source was already a streaming fanout, so no redundant full projection copy is claimed.
Peak buffer memory decreased while rows scanned increased. Single-query latency changed little. No concurrency performance claim or promotion is included.
Negative functional cases preserve error precedence and successful reuse. These results do not prove hard physical allocator containment.
